Parser2GIS by Andy Trofimov and the Eroloft fork contributors: https://github.com/Eroloft/parser-2gis-new, commit a773258a12d70f6523beaba8d7d63f2dfccecfdb, licensed LGPL-3.0. The adapted source is in `parser_2gis/`, with local RENKAI callbacks, link recognition, refreshed nodes after page changes, and access-status handling. The original browser-identification behavior is retained. See `parser-2gis-LGPL-3.0.txt`.

RENKAI 0.1.3 additionally reads the JSON state embedded in ordinary public 2GIS HTML documents, extracts same-branch price evidence, and resolves cities against the upstream catalog. The public-page transport is in `parser_2gis/parser/page_data.py`; the original catalog parser remains available without the RENKAI page-data flag. Source errors and access challenges do not authorize bypassing protections.
